Fiaフィア 菲娅
Aliases	Kami-sama, 神様, 神さま (Iol), Megami-sama, 女神様, 縁結びの神様, 縁結びの女神
Hair	Ahoge, Hair Beads, Intake, Sidehair, Straight, V Bangs, Waist Length+, White
Eyes	Blue, Tareme
Body	Fang, Medium Breasts, Mole, Pale, Slim, Teen
Clothes	Armband, Arm Cuffs, Body Ribbon, Brooch, Christmas Cap, Clothing with Ribbons, Gloves, Hair Ribbon, High Heeled Sandals, Ornament Hanging from Clothes, Pajamas, Pendant NecklaceS, Ribbon Tie, Strapless Panties, Thigh Band, Unusual Hair Ornaments
Items	Bow
Personality	Assertive, Carefree, Cheerful, Deredere, Energetic, Friendly, Jealous, Kind, Loud, Outgoing, Watashi, Whimsical
Role	Cupid, DaughterS, Deity, GirlfriendS, Magician
Engages in	Fighting, Flirting
Subject of	Amnesia, Avoidable Death (obsolete)S, Confinement
Voiced by	Sawasawa Sawa
Description

The self-proclaimed "Goddess of relationships" who is awoken from her long inactivity inside the Guaracouna fortress by Avaro. She makes Avaro her apostle and seeks his help in reaching 神響の霞廊 together with the fortress which she sees as part of her body. Fia has amnesia and is unable to remember why she wants to reach her intended destination.

The Guaracouna fortress is a mobile castle which looks like an enormous turtle and is capable of movement when Fia derives enough power from helping civilians and restoring stricken lands to vitality. To this end she forms the Guaracouna trading company together with Avaro as the best way of gathering enough power to move the fortress.

Easy-going and friendly with a happy-go-lucky disposition, Fia believes in talking through disagreements and avoiding military conflict unless absolutely forced to. She relies heavily on Avaro to get the party out of dire straits through his ingenious inventions, yet is also capable of helping out in the trading company's daily activities and is sometimes asked to help Avaro with his inventions by invoking assistance from elemental spirits.

In the True Ending, Fia succeeds in reaching her destination and saving her father Paraia from confinement. In the bad ending, she is killed by Avaro at her bequest to save innocent people from the destruction she was poised to bring. We assume we're in the story after the true ending. In true ending append stories, Avaro and Fia also meet a spirit of bad ending's Fia, ultimately leading to a twin threesome relationship.

菲娅几乎总是保持乐观积极的态度，作为女神却没有架子，但是却像女神和信徒那样经常给予Avaro/阿瓦罗慰藉和鼓励，同时也会期望阿瓦罗来和菲娅互动，并且露出娇羞的一面。通过一路上的结伴历险，菲娅和阿瓦罗/Avaro结下了深厚的羁绊和爱情。偶尔，菲娅也会小小腹黑一下调侃阿瓦罗和别的女孩子进行了亲密互动（做爱），但是作为结缘的女神，她并不反对这一点，只要阿瓦罗还是最爱她的那个女神的使徒就好。

菲娅的身体女神般完美无瑕，丰满的胸部体现出作为女神的包容力她的衣服以白色为主，辅以蓝色布料，衬托出菲娅的可爱。菲娅的服装特色是她一身露出侧乳的暴露衣服，左侧的侧乳上还有一颗痣，更加增加了菲娅的色气程度。上下身的衣服完全连体，侧面完全没有布料，从侧乳到大腿一览无余，不过，菲娅确实穿着贴合结构的内裤。菲娅的右侧额头上有一个特征性的蓝金色星星装饰。总体上，菲娅的服侍在可爱中具有反差的色气。

After the events in her own game, she travels to Grasesta after the dolls of legend created by Avaro to promote his atelier slip from her control. With help from Judar and his party, all eight of the dolls are subdued and Fia stays behind with the dolls to help Judar with his quest in gratitude for his assistance.
